title: Chapter 446 The Generals Return
content:
Chapter 446 The Generals Return

In Shanhai City, Zhao Bangde and others returned quietly.

This trip to the secret realm yielded unimaginable gains.

Zhao Bangde, Zhu Dongheng, Gong Zheng and nine others have all been promoted to the level of senior generals.

The rest of the others have also been upgraded to the level of intermediate generals.

Moreover, Zhao Bangde has completely mastered the secret realm and can continuously upgrade the ranks of the generals.

If the Demon King knew that this secret realm was so important, he would never give it to Wang Shuo for free.

The returning people saw that the monsters were attacking the city, and they immediately started fighting without saying a word.

Under the leadership of Zhao Bangde and others, the monsters were killed and retreated step by step.

It didn't take long for the crisis of Shanhai City to be resolved.

When Zhao Bangde learned that there were still a large number of monster main forces in Wana City, he led everyone to kill without hesitation.

With the addition of nine senior generals, the situation became one-sided.

The previous role reversal, Dahuai Domain became the party that raised the butcher knife.

The monster was quickly killed and repelled.

Everyone cheered immediately.

Ayub saw Zhao Bangde and others saving Wana City from crisis, and immediately told Zhao Bangde the news that Wang Shuo was still at the Great Wall.

Zhao Bangde was shocked and rushed to the Great Wall again.

Wang Shuo, after two days and two nights of fighting, finally reached the limit of his body.

Even with the blessing of the Shura suit, his condition was very bad.

At this time, his spirit was extremely excited, but also extremely sleepy.

It was like insomnia, wanting to sleep but unable to sleep.

Suddenly, a "mountain pressing down on the top", Gong Zheng fell from the sky.

With one move, the monsters around Wang Shuo were shocked.

A large number of human masters came.

Rag was stunned by shock.

"Don't let a single monster run away!"

This was the last sentence Wang Shuo heard.

He finally fell down.

Zhao Bangde kicked a monster away and was deeply shocked by the scene in front of him.

The corpses of monsters were piled up like mountains around.

...

I don't know how long it took.

Wang Shuo woke up.

Seeing the bedroom in front of him, Wang Shuo relaxed.

He hadn't slept so soundly for a long time.

"Lord, wake up!"

A waiter shouted.

Zhao Bangde, Gong Zheng and others immediately rushed into Wang Shuo's bedroom.

"Lord, are you okay?!"

Wang Shuo looked at these familiar faces and was suddenly very moved.

"You worked hard in this battle!"

Zhao Bangde handled the military and political affairs of Dahuai Territory and understood the cruelty of this battle.

It can be said that without Wang Shuo, Dahuai Territory would have been a paradise for monsters.

Wang Shuo single-handedly held back most of the high-end combat power of the monsters, which saved the three human cities in Dahuai Territory.

Of course, if Zhao Bangde and others came back a few days later, Dahuai Domain might not exist anymore.

Wang Shuo coughed, cleared his throat, and whispered: "The monsters have been repelled!"

"Yes, not a single one was let go!"

Wang Shuo was completely relieved.

Then, he sat up.

After a few days of rest, his condition had recovered to its peak.

Everyone returned to the meeting hall.

Wang Shuo was shocked to learn about Zhao Bangde's gains from this trip.

This three-star secret realm actually has such an effect.

He immediately wanted to go in and experience it.

But Zhao Bangde poured cold water on him: "This secret realm has almost no effect on high-level warriors."

Wang Shuo was a little disappointed.
